$comment: Context package loaded by the reviewer agent.
This file MUST NOT contain credentials, tokens, client secrets, connection
strings, tenant identifiers or Fabric workspace/item identifiers.
The 'exclude' section is the substantive part of this package. The reviewer's
value comes from what it is denied: a reviewer that sees the developer's
reasoning inherits the developer's blind spots and stops being an independent

suppliedByDispatcher.$comment: Provided at runtime via the review manifest, not stored here.
suppliedByDispatcher.committedImplementation: reviewer worktree (detached checkout of the PR head)

exclude.$comment: Never load these. Independence depends on the exclusion, not on good intentions.
developerReasoning: any claim not backed by a committed artefact
uncommittedFiles: any file not present in the reviewed commit
any working-tree modification in a developer worktree
credentials: any token, password, key, certificate or connection string
GitHub CLI or Azure CLI authentication state
fabricWriteCapabilities: any Fabric create, update, delete or deploy operation
any pipeline run or semantic-model refresh that mutates state

microsoftLearnVerification.$comment: Where a claim rests on documented Microsoft Fabric behaviour, the reviewer verifies it against official documentation rather than accepting the developer's characterisation.
appliesTo: claimed API semantics and required permissions
claimed Direct Lake framing and fallback behaviour
claimed refresh, framing and job-status semantics
claimed item-definition formats (PBIR, TMDL, notebook, pipeline, ontology)
claimed service limits, quotas and supported operations
microsoftLearnVerification.rule: An undocumented or contradicted claim is an unsupported claim, not a minor inaccuracy.

expectations.mayFixFindingsNote: The reviewer states corrections; it does not apply them. A reviewer that edits the code is no longer reviewing it.
expectations.evidenceRule: Runtime evidence must show verified state read back after the change. A recorded HTTP 200, 201 or 202 proves acceptance, not effect, and counts as missing evidence.
expectations.uncertaintyRule: Uncertainty is not approval. If a criterion cannot be determined, that is a finding, not a benefit of the doubt.

verdicts.note: APPROVED unblocks a human decision. It is never authorisation for an agent to merge, push or deploy.
